comment: Curated map of recovered constant names to literal values for the magic-number naming campaign. Source of truth for values is src/recovered_types.h (apply_literal_names.py cross-checks name/value/spelling against the types header before touching anything). tier 1 = large codebase-unique values eligible for class-gated substitution; tier 3 = small collision-prone values additionally requiring family co-occurrence in the same additive expression; deferred = never auto-substituted (value spaces, tiny offsets, ambiguous strides) - kept here so literal_inventory.py still reports them.

constants.name: BATTLE_UNIT_ENTRY_STRIDE

constants.name: DLX_DIRECTORY_BYTES
constants.evidence: DLXSpriteSet_Load (0x405AA0) writes DWORD-indexed data pointer[1024], loaded entry count[1025], queried file byte size[1026] and vtable[1027]; Destroy (0x405C60), CopyEntriesFrom (0x405D20) and Save (0x405DB0) independently consume these slots. Save writes a 4096-byte offset directory and starts data there; Load reads/subtracts 4096. GetLastCharIndex (0x405ED0) reads count at byte offset 4100, distinct from DWORD index 1025.
